column1: # A BRANCH OF THE LUWINSKI FAMILY FLEW FROM BERLIN TO AUSTRALIA IN 1965.
# Arolsen Archives, DocID 81709354, opened 20 September 2026 after David ticked the consent declaration.
# WHAT THE DOCUMENT IS. A nominal roll of the Intergovernmental Committee for European Migration,
# filed under "3 Registrations and Files of Displaced Persons, Children and Missing Persons /
# 3.1 Evidence of Abode and Emigration / 3.1.3 EMIGRATIONS / Correspondence and nominal rolls, done at
# Bad Godesberg, Bremen-Lesum, Madrid, München, Nürnberg: TRANSPORT BY AIRPLANE". Reference 2028000,
# 694 documents, created July to December 1965. The sheet is headed MELBOURNE, numbered BGO 65/135,
# NATIONAL PAGE A 3, marked "AUSTRALIAN GOVERNMENT FINANCIALLY ASSISTED", and the reverse carries a
# date stamp of SEPTEMBER 1965.

column1: two children
column2: aged 10 and 3, born 1955 and 1961. THEY ARE FLAGGED LIVING IN THE FAMILY TREE AND ARE NOT NAMED HERE. The build's own guard would refuse the page if they were.

column1: where they were going
column2: the sheet is headed MELBOURNE — the port of arrival for the flight — and the family's forwarding line reads "c/o Mr H. MARQUARDT, ... HACKETT, CANBERRA ACT". THE STREET IS NOT PUBLISHED HERE: it is a private residential address attached to people who may be living.

column1: and the sponsor's surname is already in the register
column2: the family tree carries Manfred's wife as "Helga Erna MARQUARDT Wagner (Luwinski)". The person receiving them in Canberra is a MARQUARDT. HER OWN FAMILY WAS ALREADY IN AUSTRALIA AND BROUGHT THEM OUT.

column1: *** AND THE BERLIN DIRECTORY LINES UP WITH IT EXACTLY ***
column2: the Berliner Adressbuch name section carries "LUWINSKI MANFRED SCHLOSSER TGL EGELLSSTR 16" in 1957, 1959 and 1961 — a fitter, in Tegel — AND NOTHING AFTER 1961. The emigration roll of 1965 gives the same man, from Berlin, as a MODEL FITTER. Schlosser and model fitter are the same trade. THE DIRECTORY LOSES HIM BECAUSE HE LEFT THE COUNTRY.

column1: *** AND THE FAMILY TREE ALREADY KNEW WHERE HE ENDED UP, WITHOUT KNOWING HOW ***
column2: the MyHeritage export gives MANFRED JOACHIM LUWINSKI, born 14 November 1933 at Berlin, DIED 20 SEPTEMBER 2012 AT BRISBANE, AUSTRALIA. It records no emigration at all. THIS DOCUMENT IS THE JOURNEY BETWEEN THOSE TWO FACTS.

column1: what it does NOT establish
column2: THAT MANFRED IS RELATED TO KURT. The MyHeritage tree places them in one family, but a user tree is the thing this archive corrects, not the thing it cites. What the document proves is the emigration, the trade, the date and the destination — not the descent.

column1: and one reason for real caution about that descent
column2: the tree makes Manfred the son of ALFRED LUWINSKI, BORN 9 SEPTEMBER 1917, and of MARTHA SCHUENKE, WHO IT SAYS DIED IN 1930. A father of sixteen and a mother dead three years before the birth. THE GENERATION IS INTERNALLY IMPOSSIBLE AS THE TREE HAS IT — see the work list.
